facts.fact: At dawn in the warden's chamber Devan takes Asha's last note from the carved box (F415) and reads Neela the full line he withheld in book 1: 'If you're reading this, I was right, and it's ugly. Say it anyway. The truth protects whoever finds it.' Neela answers with his own words, 'Thank you for telling me.' Replaces F1037.
Devan returns the whole oilcloth bundle to the hollow the night before, so at dawn Neela finds chit, writ and gift seal together, tied with red thread. Replaces F1036.
